svg.text: ipo-price-model — the gate, and the tests that are the claims

g.text: withheld: no_range — the interval is shown for audit, not for use
The publication gate — checked in this order, first failure is the reason
the most informative T-1 fact is absent; printing would be guessing
fewer than 5 comparable listings in the trailing window
the market has not spoken recently enough
the 80% interval spans more than 60% of the offer
'between half and double' is honest, and useless
The gate never narrows an interval. It decides whether to show one.
$ pytest -v # the claims in METHODOLOGY.md, executable — no network, no keys
a label on or before T-1, a shuffled split, an undeclared feature: all raise
the regime sees nothing that closed on or after the decision date
fewer than 5 comparables: unknown, not estimated
the feature list is the declared list, nothing more
80% nominal coverage holds on data the model never saw
log-space interval maps to price; the lower edge cannot go below zero
the gate decides whether to print, never what
